name: War Economy and External Dependency Strain
title: Russia–Ukraine · War Economy and External Dependency Strain

definition.question: How strained and externally dependent are the belligerents' war economies and sustainment?
definition.low_end: Diversified, self-sufficient war economies with stable budgets and secure supply chains for critical military inputs.
definition.high_end: Acute fiscal and supply-chain crisis with critical dependence on a single external patron for energy revenues and dual-use military inputs, forcing severe trade-offs.
